g.text: > All examples in these docs use `mcpjam` directly. If you installed via `npx`,
These stay at the program root. They reject `--api-key` / `--api-url` / `--project` — except `test`, which accepts them only to re
| [`test`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/local-evals) | Run an eval suite file locally (BYOK or MCPJam-hosted inference); never uplo
| [`subscriptions`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference) | Open a long-lived MCP subscription and stream notifications | `listen
| [`tasks`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/tasks) | Drive MCP Tasks and validate the tasks wire | `list`, `get`, `cancel`, `conforman
| [`events`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/events) | List, poll, watch and subscribe to MCP Events (triggers), and check their confo
| [`apps`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/apps-conformance) | Validate MCP Apps metadata and resource wiring | `conformance`, `confor
| [`oauth`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/oauth-conformance) | Test OAuth flows and conformance against an MCP server | `conformance
| [`readiness`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference#readiness-hosted-commands) | Grade a server against a publisher's directory.
Hosted `start` / `status` / `list` / `cancel` / `report` stay here (leaf `--api-key`; no Cloud project link) | `check`, `start cl
| [`xaa`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/xaa) | Run the Cross-App Access (ID-JAG) debugger against an MCP server | `run` |
| [`compat`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference#compat-command) | Check whether a server's tools and widgets work on each AI ho
| [`inspector`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference#inspector-commands) | Start, open, or stop the local Inspector from the CLI
| [`mcp`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/mcp-server) | Run MCPJam as a stdio MCP server for agents (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Curs
| [`telemetry`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/telemetry) | Inspect and configure anonymous CLI telemetry | `status`, `disable`, `ena
Account-bound commands. Declare `--api-key` / `--api-url` on `mcpjam cloud` (before or after descendants). `mcpjam oauth login` is
MCP-server OAuth; `mcpjam cloud login` is your MCPJam account.
| [`cloud eval`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference#cloud-eval-commands) | Author and run eval suites in your hosted MCPJam pro
| [`cloud tunnel`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference#cloud-tunnel) | Expose a local MCP server through a public MCPJam tunnel
URL, registered as a server in your project | `tunnel --server <name> <url>`, `tunnel --server <name> -- <command>` |
| [`cloud clients`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference#cloud-clients-commands) | Manage clients in your hosted MCPJam projects
st + servers + pinned skills/plugins bundles eval suites and goals run against | `list`, `get`, `resolve`, `create`, `update`, `ar
| [`cloud skills`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference#cloud-skills-commands) | List and read Cloud Skills in your hosted MCPJam
